mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined below 0.2% over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for three consecutive months, it signals severe labor market distress that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS above 0.1% and UNRATE above 9.0% signal a monetary tightening cycle coinciding with labor market weakness, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.1 and UNRATE > 9.0, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery phases, residential construction permits (HOUST) exceeding 550 thousand units signal strengthening housing demand that boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of post-recession recovery periods when HOUST > 550, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) above 129,000 thousand persons over the past 3 months indicates improving job market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 129,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction starts (HOUST) fall below 550 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals housing market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 550 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in real GDP (GDPC1) above 13,100 billion dollars and industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 index signal robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 13100 and INDPRO > 100, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 4.0% signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs that depress equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
